articles.summary: CareDx, Inc. (Nasdaq: CDNA) — a leading precision medicine diagnostics company in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy, today announced the company will participate in the following investor conferences: Evercore 9th Annual Healthcare Conference at The Loews Coral Gables Hotel in Coral Gables, FL. Fireside chat on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 1:45pm ET. Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference at the Lotte New York Palace in New York, NY. Fireside chat on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 3:30pm ET. Live and archived webcasts of the presentations will be available on the “Events and Presentations” section of the CareDx investor relations website at investors.caredx.com . About CareDx CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through non-invasive longitudinal molecular biomarker testing, digital health, and patient support solutions, CareDx is dedicated to improving patient outcomes.

articles.summary: CareDx, Inc. (Nasdaq: CDNA) — a leading precision medicine diagnostics company in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy, today announced the award of inducement grants. On November 5, 2026, as an inducement material to acceptance of employment with CareDx, 21 new employees were awarded restricted stock units (RSUs) for an aggregate of 33,375 shares of common stock. The RSUs will vest over four years, with 25% of the RSUs vesting on the first anniversary of each employee’s vesting commencement date, and 1/16th of the RSUs vesting on each date that is three (3) months thereafter subject to each employee’s continued service through each vesting date. The RSU awards were made pursuant to the Company’s 2025 Inducement Equity Incentive Plan in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4). articles.summary: AlloSure® Kidney trajectories within the first four months post-transplant were associated with three-year graft outcomes CareDx, Inc. (Nasdaq: CDNA) — a leading precision medicine diagnostics company in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy, today announced the publication of a new analysis from the Kidney Allograft Outcomes AlloSure Registry (KOAR), a landmark multicenter study, in the journal Transplantation . The third manuscript from KOAR investigated the correlation between early post-transplant AlloSure Kidney donor-derived cell-free DNA (dd-cfDNA) levels and three-year kidney allograft outcomes in a multicenter cohort of 1,137 kidney transplant recipients across 56 centers. Recipients were categorized into trajectory groups based on AlloSure Kidney measurements obtained within the first four months post-transplant: consistently low, transient-elevation, late-elevation, and persistent-elevation.
